lead.headline: Gordon is in; Coker is still unclaimed
lead.deck: 2-5. The lineup is the projection lineup. One move left: the Coker claim, before Wednesday 02:00.
lead.body: Start with what is still wrong. Jalen Coker, dropped by mistake on Wednesday, played 86% of Carolina's snaps on Thursday and scored for nobody; he sits on Chem waivers until Wednesday 4 November at 02:00, and this brief cannot see whether the claim is in. Garrett Wilson drew three targets last week while rookie Omar Cooper Jr. took over the Jets' passing game. The fix the last three briefs asked for is made: Ollie Gordon II went into the flex at 21:43 UTC and DK Metcalf to the bench. Friday's final reports name no AVIATO starter; Rico Dowdle, Jaylen Warren's backup, is questionable with a knee. 130.2 to Guillo-tinas' 89.5, 70%.
